title: TrainExplorer: Autonomous LLM Post-Training via Plan-and-Decouple Exploration
abstract: arXiv:2611.20430v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM-based agents can automate model post-training, accelerating progress toward recursive self-improvement. Despite their promise, existing approaches remain under-explored and face two main challenges: (1) strategy lock-in that limits exploration beyond the initial strategy; and (2) coupled execution that obscures the effects of individual modifications. To address these challanges, we propose TrainExplorer, a multi-agent framework for autonomous post-training, that incorporates strategy planning and execution decoupling, to achieve broaden strategy exploration. First, strategy planning draws on scientific literature to construct a candidate search space of training strategies. Then, decoupled execution enables single-component interventions and attribution to guide strategy exploration. Extensive experiments on PostTrainBench demonstrate that TrainExplorer achieves a weighted aggregate score of 39.02, outperforming Claude Code using

translated_title: TrainExplorer：通过规划与解耦探索实现自主的大语言模型后训练
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型的智能体能够自动化模型后训练过程，加速迈向递归自我改进的进程。尽管前景广阔，现有方法仍缺乏充分探索，并面临两大主要挑战：（1）策略锁定，即难以探索初始策略之外的方案；（2）耦合执行，即难以辨析单项修改的具体效果。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了 TrainExplorer——一个用于自主后训练的多智能体框架，它融合了策略规划与执行解耦，以实现更广泛的策略探索。首先，策略规划借鉴科学文献来构建训练策略的候选搜索空间；随后，解耦执行支持单组件干预与效果归因，从而引导策略探索。在 PostTrainBench 上的大量实验表明，TrainExplorer 取得了 39.02 的加权综合得分，超越了 Claude Code……
tldr: 提出多智能体框架 TrainExplorer，通过借鉴科学文献的策略规划与单组件干预的执行解耦机制，实现自主的大语言模型后训练策略探索，在 PostTrainBench 上取得 39.02 的加权综合得分并超越 Claude Code。
en_tdlr: TrainExplorer is a multi-agent framework for autonomous LLM post-training that combines literature-informed strategy planning with decoupled single-component execution, achieving a weighted aggregate score of 39.02 on PostTrainBench and outperforming Claude Code.
